title: Do This 2 Minute Arm Pump Before You Take Your Shirt Off
hook: Do this before a photo shoot or a pool party.
body: 30 seconds of bicep curls, 30 seconds of side laterals, 30 seconds of overhead tricep extensions, then 30 seconds of rest. One round gives you a quick pump. Three or four rounds is a full home arm workout.
close: Save this for the next time you take your shirt off.
youtube_description:
The 2 minute arm pump I do before a photo shoot or a pool party. All you need is a pair of dumbbells.

Try your free Abs By AI preview: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=arms-shoulders-home-workout&utm_content=sl04-short2

1. 30 seconds of bicep curls
2. 30 seconds of side lateral raises
3. 30 seconds of overhead tricep extensions
4. 30 seconds of rest

One round for a quick pump, three or four rounds for a full home workout.
